description: Hermes Knowledge OS v2 maintenance jobs — Phase G enablement after CRITICAL-clean + manual runs.

never_auto: policy / AGENTS.md / SCHEMA.md / Hermes instruction rewrites

jobs.prompt: Knowledge OS lint (read-only): Run `python scripts/knowledge_os_lint.py` against Growth OS (Mac path or VPS /opt/hermes/data/obsidian/Growth OS). Summarize CRITICAL/WARN counts. Do not merge, ingest, archive, promote, or rewrite pages. If CRITICAL>0, list paths and stop.

Knowledge OS daily: Load wiki-daily; orient on hot.md + indexes only. Refresh hot.md if focus changed (≤150 words). List unprocessed raw/ from last 48h. Compile with wiki-ingest only when needed, status ≤ CONNECTED/VERIFIED. Update indexes. Append compile-log. Do not set CANONICAL. Do not edit raw/**. Do not treat Business Context or archive/para-migration as SoT.

Knowledge OS nightly: Run wiki-lint. Auto-fix only safe issues (index rows, missing DRAFT frontmatter defaults). Write findings under workspace/review-queues/ or workspace/drafts/. Propose merges/duplicates/stale; do not CANONICAL, do not delete/archive substantive knowledge, do not edit raw/**, do not rewrite AGENTS/SCHEMA/policies.

Knowledge OS weekly: Orient; lint; list CONNECTED/VERIFIED promote candidates; create/update packages under workspace/promotions/ via wiki-promote but do not apply without Dylan. Do not delete redirect stubs.

Knowledge OS monthly: Lint then propose archive/ontology updates under workspace/review-queues/. No raw deletes. No CANONICAL edits. No autonomous archive of substantive knowledge. No unapproved file moves.
